_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); beverage and convenient-food signals

pit_profile.why: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global snack and beverage company'; 'Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets', 'In U.S. measured channels, we have a similar share of CSD (carbonated soft drinks) consumption and a larger share of liquid refreshment beverages consumption, as compared to our chief beverage competitor, The Coca-Cola Company', and 'Our success depends on our ability to respond to consumer trends, such as consumer health concerns about obesity, product attributes and ingredients' (its own FY2007 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global snack and beverage company'; 'Our businesses operate in highly competitive markets', 'In U.S. measured channels, we have a similar share of CSD (carbonated soft drinks) consumption and a larger share of liquid refreshment beverages consumption, as compared to our chief beverage competitor, The Coca-Cola Company', and 'Our success depends on our ability to respond to consumer trends, such as consumer health concerns about obesity, product attributes and ingredients' (its own FY2007 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.23x; +10% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.12; conservative 2yr +48%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -8.9%/yr (worst year FY98-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +16.0%/yr (Q4 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.0%/yr (FY98-FY07 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY98-FY07); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PEP (retrospective, 2008-04-18) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.23x (22.1% downside to Bear $55 / +94.1% upside to Bull $137) | Adj composite 2.83 vs market 1.71: gap +1.12 [UNDERVALUED] | +10% above the EPP floor $64 (19x FY08E $3.38) | Conservative 2-yr case: +47.6% total (+23.8%/yr) | At 20.9x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $93 sits at or below the BASE case; servings +5.0% in Q4 2007, forward revenues +17% (Q4 2007 net revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: PepsiCo FY2007 10-K
sources.supports: five-year summary 2003-2007; income statement 2005-2007 (2005-2006 operating profit reclassified for certain international bottling interests); inventories 2006-2007; division net revenue 2005-2007; total servings growth 2006 and 2007; cash flow (operating activities $6,934M, capital spending $2,430M, sales of PP&E $47M, repurchases $4,300M, dividends $2,204M); quarterly dividends declared ($0.375 in the fourth quarter); business, competition and risk-factor wording

sources.title: PepsiCo FY2006 10-K
sources.supports: five-year summary 2002-2006 (diluted EPS, continuing operations from 2004; net revenue); income statement 2004-2006; inventories 2005-2006; division net revenue 2004-2006; total servings growth 2005 and 2006; cash flow (operating activities $6,084M, capital spending $2,068M, sales of PP&E $49M, repurchases $3,000M, dividends $1,854M); quarterly dividends declared ($0.30 in the fourth quarter); fiscal year ends on the last Saturday of each December; business, competition and risk-factor wording

sources.title: PepsiCo FY2005 10-K
